Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Suresh - 37 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Sharda - 73 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay paints a picture.]

Tanay: "That was fun!"

[Tanay sneezes loudly.]

Tanay: "Mom, listen!"

[Tanay trips over a stone and falls.]

Tanay: "And then?"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Tanay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
